title: oncall: enhance auto-diagnostics and runbook linking for SLO toolkit integration
author: Samira Patel
description: Context: on-call engineers rely on incident-bot to surface SLO context, related runbooks, and quick remediation steps. Motivation: the current auto-diagnostics frequently surfaces noisy runbook suggestions and does not surface SLO change history or paginated runbook summaries. This PR improves runbook linking precision, enriches diagnostics with SLO metadata and recent changes, and adds on-call UI shortcuts for quicker action. Summary of changes: 1) Add runbook linker that ranks runbooks by SLO correlation score and recent edit recency; 2) Extend SLO toolkit helpers to expose change history and alert fingerprinting used in diagnostics; 3) Improve on-call UI with a compact runbook summary and one-click copy-to-clipboard for remediation commands; 4) Add experiment flags and rollout plan (10% canary -> 50% -> 100%) to ensure safe rollout; 5) Add e2e coverage for typical SLO-related incidents. Checklist: - [x] Implement linker algorithm and unit tests - [x] Expose SLO history API and privacy-preserving diff - [x] UI changes behind feature flag - [x] Add integration/e2e tests and CI coverage - [x] Docs and runbook README updates Testing and validation: unit tests added for ranking and SLO history, integration tests run in CI; manual validation performed on staging with oncall team using synthetic incidents. Rollout plan: feature-flagged canary at 10% for 48h, monitoring for false positives and runbook click-through rate; gradual ramp to 100% if metrics stable. Related: ENG-4128 implements backend metric emitted for ranking health, SUP-2345 is a support ticket that motivated the SLO history view. Notes: no customer-breaking changes; potential for minor UX tweaks after canary.
